title: I didn’t know this was possible with Perplexity Computer #shorts
description:
I can’t believe I just built this…

This might be the most valuable tool ever created for New York real estate.

It lets you pick any neighborhood in New York City, and get a live leaderboard of the most underpriced or overpriced apartments.

Full interactive map, with a pricing algorithm based on neighborhood, distance to subway, local coffee shop, everything.

But here’s the craziest part…

I built this entire thing in two prompts with Perplexity Computer.

If you haven’t used this, it is my #1 AI tool right now.

Think of Computer like a master layer on top of all the best AI models in the world.

It can run Anthropic’s latest version of Opus, OpenAI’s latest GPT, Google’s latest version of Gemini or Nano Banana…all at the same time.

And this is what makes it so 1 of 1.

When you give it any project, it’ll break it down into tasks and route work to whichever AI model is best for that specific piece.

We all know each AI model is great at different things…Perplexity Computer lets you use all of them at the same time.

So for the real estate tool, it used all of those models, plus live Zillow and Google Maps data.

All from a simple prompt.

Now to make sure this wasn’t a fluke, I also built The Ultimate NYC Burger Tracker.

It maps the top 25 burgers in New York City and has a live group scorecard

So you and 4 friends could sample all the best burgers over a year, rate them individually, and it will live update as you do it.

I’m telling you, as soon as you use Computer, you realize what an unfair advantage it is to stitch together all the world's best models and AI agents in one shot.
